display_long_description:
Join Albo and Alba in a charming puzzle adventure built around teamwork, timing, and clever thinking.

In this Tiny Tandem, you control two lovable companions who move together through a series of handcrafted challenges. What seems simple at first quickly becomes a test of coordination as rotating obstacles, moving hazards, and creative puzzle mechanics stand between you and the goal.

Every level introduces new ideas and fresh challenges, encouraging you to observe, plan, and master each puzzle. Success depends on guiding both Albo and Alba safely through the environment, because neither can reach the goal alone.

Designed for VR and mixed reality, Tiny Tandem transforms puzzle solving into a fun and immersive experience that's easy to learn and satisfying to master.

Features:

• Control two characters at the same time
• Solve handcrafted cooperative style puzzles
• Discover new mechanics as you progress
• Test your timing, coordination, and problem solving skills
• Play in VR and mixed reality
• Enjoy a charming and accessible experience suitable for all ages

Can you guide Albo and Alba through every challenge and bring them safely to the goal?
